title: Job Scheduling (Binary Search DP)

monster.name: Opportunity Lich
monster.title: Scheduler of Maximum Profit Intervals
monster.defeatQuote: Max non-overlapping job profit scheduled with binary search DP!

description: We have `n` jobs, where every job is scheduled to be done from `startTime[i]` to `endTime[i]`, obtaining a profit of `profit[i]`. You're given the `startTime`, `endTime` and `profit` arrays, return the maximum profit you can take such that there are no two jobs in the subset with overlapping time range.
starterCode:
def jobScheduling(startTime: list[int], endTime: list[int], profit: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def jobScheduling(startTime: list[int], endTime: list[int], profit: list[int]) -> int:
    import bisect
    jobs = sorted(zip(startTime, endTime, profit), key=lambda x: x[1])
    dp = [(0, 0)]  # (endTime, maxProfit)
    for s, e, p in jobs:
        # Binary search for job finishing <= s
        idx = bisect.bisect_right(dp, (s, float('inf'))) - 1
        total_profit = dp[idx][1] + p
        if total_profit > dp[-1][1]:
            dp.append((e, total_profit))
    return dp[-1][1]
hints: Sort by end times. For each job, binary search the latest non-overlapping job in DP array.
